reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Vitamin Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: My skin felt brighter and more refreshed after using this mask. It’s lightweight, not sticky, and gives a nice glow. Great for a quick skincare boost.
reviews.zh: 用完呢款面膜之後，皮膚感覺提亮咗、更清爽。質地輕盈，唔黏笠，仲有自然光澤。非常適合快速為皮膚加分。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Vitamin Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: These masks from SOME BY MI are great. I got them in a sale so they were even better value, and I like that there are many options for different types of skin. My skin concerns depend on the time of year, so this is great for me to be able to buy individual masks at lower cost
reviews.zh: SOME BY MI 嘅呢啲面膜好正。我係特價嘅時候買嘅，所以更加抵，而且我鍾意佢有好多唔同選擇可以配合唔同膚質。我嘅皮膚問題會按季節而變，所以能夠以較低價錢單獨買到唔同面膜對我嚟講好方便。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Vitamin Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Excellent sheet mask fit. It hydrates the skin beautifully and gives a great result. The ingredients work very well, especially if you use this type of mask every day or every other day. Provides excellent hydration — highly recommended.
reviews.zh: 片裝面膜嘅貼服度一流。可以為皮膚提供出色嘅保濕，效果好好。尤其係如果你日日或者隔日用呢類型嘅面膜，成分發揮得更加好。提供卓越嘅保濕效果——強烈推薦。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Vitamin Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Super padre hidratan muy bien la cara y la dejan súper bonita y glowy me encantaron además venían con un limpiador facial que también súper padre era de regalo con la borla !! 1000 de 100
reviews.zh: 超正，保濕效果好好，用完塊面超靚超有光澤，我好鍾意，仲送咗一支面部清潔劑做贈品，連粉撲都有！！1000 分滿分

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Vitamin Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: I already tried it once and really loved how it brightened post-acne dark spot significantly in one use, so I ordered again
reviews.zh: 我之前試過一次，真係好鍾意佢用一次就明顯提亮咗暗瘡印，所以再訂咗。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Vitamin Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Didn’t see any affect but I guess it’s because I only tried once so I don’t know but it’s moisturising
reviews.zh: 冇見到任何效果，但我想可能只係用過一次所以唔清楚，不過有保濕。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Vitamin Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: I just received them today and i bought it as it was on good sale. So i decided to give it a try. and if it works well for me, i will buy again.
reviews.zh: 我今日啱啱收到，因為特價所以買咗，決定試下。如果啱用嘅話會再買。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Vitamin Brightening Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text:
The smell is very good. 
I still didn't saw the effect. I just have used it twice. 
But I saw alot of feedback before
reviews.zh: 味道好好。我仲未見到效果，只係用過兩次。但我之前睇過好多用後感。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
